runtime.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 5 3550H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx

source.algorithm: C++ csl.finite_action_minimax; four signed linear terminal components combined into max(abs(y),abs(z)) per fixed plan
source.timing_scope: Each per-decision solve interval includes request construction, four finite_action_minimax calls (signed y/z components), plan combination and tie selection. Episode state setup, JSON serialization and SVG/HTML rendering are excluded.
source.deadline: 50 ms per decision, checked after the native call returns; the current solver call is not interruptible
source.limiter_profile: not collected; no speedup or performance-winner claim
source.numeric_method: binary64; independent source replay uses absolute and relative tolerance 2e-12
source.scope: Finite action and disturbance catalogues, four-step episode, complete finite disturbance-history enumeration; not a continuous RL reproduction
